## F-Commerce AI Sprint (Anchor — ৳50,000)
What you get in 14 days:
- Trained Bangla DM auto-reply agent (FAQ + order intake + lead capture)
- Complete order management system (DM → delivery tracking)
- bKash / Nagad payment workflow (<5 min confirmation)
- Automated customer re-engagement sequences
- Daily revenue dashboard in Notion
- Full team training + video documentation
